annotations.title: Export a quote in Nero Work format

description: The quote in the exact argument shape of the Nero Work exchange's submit_quote tool (labour_minor, materials_minor, vat_minor in pence, validity_hours, exclusions, notes), checked with Nero Work's own rules. If the customer accepted with extras, they are included.

trade_key.description: The trade's secret key from setup_trade (starts qbk_).
